dct_description_sm: Myanmar administrative level 0-5 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 5 levels: - Admin 1: 18 State/Region - Admin 2: 80 District - Admin 3: 330 Township - Admin 4: 14174 Town / Village tract, partial coverage - Admin 5: 1999 , partial coverage Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 15 February 2024: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 11 March 2024: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 11 March 2024: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
